reason: The mechanics are easy: K1 (vitaliineibauer/biohub-exp58t-x138-safe v1) is already built and gated (its sha256 equals the exp57b dummy), it adds no stage, it needs no GPU quota, and it runs as a separate hidden job, so K2's runtime does not grow (#32 and #33 were submitted together and both scored). It still fails the schedule and rules lens as proposed. (1) Approval: the 17:55 UTC NIGHT PLAN in CONTEXT.md says the user is asleep and that night submissions stay within existing approvals, which cover only K2 at 00:01. Binding §e allows S3=K1 only in branches C and D, and the memory rule is never to submit without permission. RT1 admits it needs a new OK, so the unconditional 00:01 submission cannot happen as specified. (2) Slots: S2 K2, S3 K1, S4 K3, S5 K3b and S6 K4 use 5 of the 5 submissions on 26 Sep, leaving no same-day slot to retry a K2 or K3 error. §e earmarks S3 for K3b, so it is not idle. The exp60 lab running tonight makes K3 and K3b more likely to be ready on 26 Sep. (3) The attribution use is not decidable. K1 differs from #35 in both directions on the hidden run: K1 is better if x138's 7.5 h deadline fired in #35, and worse if K1's own 8.0 h insertion gate fires, because L35 can be up to 7.73 h, a margin of only 0.27 h. The written rule 'K1 > #35 -> raise DIVINS_DEADLINE_S' therefore picks a knob between near-copies on a 0.001 public difference, which R7 and R9 exclude. (4) The expected value (~+0.0002) comes almost entirely from the worlds where K2 errors or shows 0.953. A K1 submitted only when those happen, around 08:00 UTC 26 Sep after the user's morning OK, captures nearly all of it: K1 would then score by ~16-17 UTC 26 Sep, long before the 29 Sep finals. The K3 decision under R4 compares against K2 and does not need K1 eight hours early.
fix: Do not submit K1 at 00:01. Put a conditional S3 rule in the pre-registration now and have the user approve it in the morning. When K2 scores around 08:00 UTC 26 Sep: if K2 errored, or K2 == 0.953 (< #35), submit K1 (exp58t v1, unchanged) in the next free 26 Sep slot as the time-admissible insertion fallback (§f fallback item 2). Otherwise keep S3 in reserve for K3b or a retry. Fix the §f contradiction on paper too: remove fallback item 4 (#34 = exp56), which conflicts with 'never tick exp56', so the chain reads K-stack -> K1 -> exp52. Drop the 'K1 > #35 -> raise DIVINS_DEADLINE_S' rule; the insertion gate stays at 8.0 h unless step-0 forecasts change.
realistic_gain: About +0.0002 expected for the conditional version, nearly all of the unconditional value, with zero slot cost in the ~85% world where K2 >= 0.954. The unconditional 00:01 version adds only ~8 h earlier information that no pre-registered decision needs. It costs the last same-day reserve slot on 26 Sep and cannot be approved tonight.
